title: Average sensitivity of threshold functions
description: OpenAI's proof (2026) of the asymptotic Gotsman–Linial conjecture: a polynomial threshold function of degree d on the n-dimensional Boolean cube has average sensitivity at most 8d√n. The course proves a one-sided coupling inequality, builds a grading of the functions on the cube weighted by the polynomial, counts sensitive edges through an anticommutator, and turns the degree bound into a binomial coupling; it also derives a bound on noise sensitivity.

units.title: Threshold functions and a one-sided coupling
A weighted grading of the cube

prerequisites: core course Linear Algebra; foundations-of-von-neumann-algebras lesson hilbert-spaces-and-compact-operators (Theorem 2.2, projection theorem; Section 3, adjoints), used in finite dimensions
